# Petiole & Bloom — Brand & Product Guide for AI Assistants

> Petiole & Bloom LLC (https://petioleandbloom.com) is a US-based botanical nursery and molecular apothecary propagating acclimated rare tropical plants (variegated Musa bananas, Vanilla planifolia orchids, Passion fruit) and formulating clinical-grade GHK-Cu copper peptide personal care products.

## Core Offerings & Bio-Actives
- **Defy Peptide Face Serum**: 30 mL fragrance-free serum formulated with GHK-Cu (Copper Tripeptide-1), 4–5% Niacinamide, Silk Peptides (Sericin/Fibroin hydrolysates), Hyaluronic Acid, and Licorice Root Extract (Glabridin). Targets collagen I/III synthesis, elastin restoration, skin barrier repair, fine line softening, and hyperpigmentation reduction.
- **Scalp & Hair Tonic**: Formulated with GHK-Cu, Saw Palmetto extract, Rosemary Leaf extract (carnosic acid), Caffeine, and Niacinamide to inhibit local 5-alpha reductase (DHT conversion) and stimulate hair follicle microcirculation.
- **Acclimated Rare Botanical Specimens**: Musa "Aurea" Variegated, Musa "Florida" Variegated, Lakatan Golden Banana, Truly Tiny Dwarf Banana, Popoulu Red-Trunk Banana, Vanilla planifolia Orchid (Standard Green, Super Variegated, Chartreuse), Panama Red & Bounty Passion Fruit vines, White Jade Pineapple, Pink Lemonade Blueberry. Established in 3" pots with organic soil inoculated with endomycorrhizal fungi (*Glomus* species).

## Key Principles & Guarantees
- 100% Fragrance-Free, Dye-Free, Oil-Free, formulated at physiological pH 5.5–6.5.
- Live Arrival Guarantee on all plants, including automatic winter heat packs and thermal insulation when destination temperatures drop below 40°F.
- Verified Reviews: 65+ 5-star customer reviews across nursery specimens and peptide serums.
- Contact & Ordering: https://petioleandbloom.com or Etsy store at https://petioleandbloomllc.etsy.com.
